newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-REFEREE HAS APPEAL AGAINST LIFE BAN REJECTED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-REFEREE HAS APPEAL AGAINST LIFE BAN REJECTED.

text.p: Swiss referee Kurt Roethlisberger had his appeal against a life ban for attempted bribery rejected by UEFA on Thursday.

Roethlisberger, once recognised as one of soccer's top officials, was suspended two weeks ago after a UEFA investigation found he had solicited a bribe to fix a European Champions' league match between Grasshopper Zurich and Auxerre on October 30 last year.
Since the decision Roethlisberger, who officiated at the 1990 and 1994 World Cup finals and the 1988 Soeul Olympics, had steadfastly maintained his innocence.
But the five-member UEFA board of appeals rejected the 48-year-old schoolteacher's explanation of the events and stood by their original ruling.
